## Pull request overview

Adds a new `os plugin` command group to the CLI for managing plugins in `objectstack.config.ts`, and introduces a comprehensive “Plugin System” guide in the docs to explain the architecture and usage.

**Changes:**
- Added `os plugin` command group (`list/ls`, `info`, `add`, `remove/rm`) and registered it in the CLI entrypoint/exports.
- Added documentation guide covering plugin architecture, lifecycle, configuration patterns, and CLI usage.
- Added/updated CLI tests to cover command registration and (simulated) config text manipulation.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/cli/src/commands/plugin.ts | Implements the new `os plugin` command group and config file text transforms. |
| packages/cli/src/bin.ts | Registers `pluginCommand` and updates CLI help workflow text. |
| packages/cli/src/index.ts | Exports the new plugin command module. |
| packages/cli/test/plugin.test.ts | Adds tests for the plugin command structure and config manipulation (via simulation). |
| packages/cli/test/commands.test.ts | Adds a basic presence check for `pluginCommand`. |
| packages/cli/README.md | Documents plugin command usage and options. |
| content/docs/guides/plugins.mdx | Adds a full plugin system guide and CLI reference. |
| content/docs/guides/meta.json | Adds the new plugins guide to the guides navigation. |
| content/docs/guides/index.mdx | Mentions plugin management as part of the CLI toolchain. |
</details>

`--dev` is defined for `os plugin add`, but the handler always calls `addPluginToConfig(configPath, packageName)` which only inserts into the `plugins:` array. This makes `os plugin add <pkg> --dev` behave like a production plugin add. Update the implementation to target `devPlugins` when `--dev` is set (and ensure the import + array entry insertion uses the selected array).

These tests “simulate what the add/remove commands do” by re-implementing the text transform logic in the test itself, rather than exercising the actual CLI implementation in `src/commands/plugin.ts`. As written, the tests can pass even if the real `addPluginToConfig`/`removePluginFromConfig` behavior regresses (e.g., handling of `devPlugins`, import placement, regex differences). Consider exporting the helpers (or moving them to a utility module) and testing them directly, or run the command actions against a temp config file.

The docs state that `os plugin add` inserts into `plugins` (or `devPlugins`) arrays, but the current CLI implementation always modifies `plugins` and ignores `--dev`. Either update the CLI to match the documented behavior, or adjust this section so it matches what the command actually does.
